input.expression: const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('a')].filter(a=>a.href.includes('/camera'));const out=[];for(const a of links){const r=await fetch(a.href);const t=await r.text();const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(t,'text/html');out.push(a.textContent+' || '+d.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' '));}return out.join('\n');
